title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Mark 7: the tradition of the elders, what truly defiles a person, the Syrophoenician woman and the deaf man who was told "Ephphatha!"

questions.text: What did the Pharisees and some of the scribes find fault with?
questions.explanation: They saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, and they found fault.

answers.text: His disciples working on the Sabbath
His disciples eating with unwashed hands
His disciples teaching in the temple

questions.text: Whose words did Jesus quote against them?
questions.explanation: He answered that Isaiah prophesied well of them, as it is written, "This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."

questions.text: What did Jesus say they did with the commandment of God?
questions.explanation: He said that they set aside the commandment of God and hold tightly to the tradition of men.

answers.text: They read it only in the synagogue
They set it aside for the tradition of men
They taught it to the multitude
They wrote it on their cups

questions.text: Which commandment of Moses did Jesus quote to them?
questions.explanation: He said, "For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother.'"

answers.text: "You shall not steal or bear false witness"

questions.text: What word did they use for a profit that was given to God?
questions.explanation: Jesus said that they allow a man to tell his father or mother that whatever profit they might have received from him is Corban, that is, given to God.

questions.text: According to Jesus, what defiles a person?
questions.explanation: He said that nothing from outside a man can defile him by going into him, but the things which proceed out of the man are what defile him.

answers.text: The things that come out of him
The food that goes into him
The cups he has not washed
The hands he has not bathed

questions.text: What did Jesus say proceeds from within, out of the hearts of men?
questions.explanation: He said that from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders and thefts.

questions.text: Who was the woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit?
questions.explanation: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race, and she begged him to cast the demon out of her daughter.

answers.text: A Greek, a Syrophoenician by race
A widow from the city of Sidon
A woman from the region of Decapolis

questions.text: What did the woman answer about the dogs under the table?
questions.explanation: She answered, "Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."

answers.text: That even the dogs eat the children's crumbs
That she would come back another day
That she would wait outside the house
That the bread should be broken for all

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the man who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech?
questions.explanation: Looking up to heaven he sighed and said to him, "Ephphatha!" that is, "Be opened!"
